title: Accepting a Change in Health
paragraphs: After an injury permanently limited his ability to play sports the way he once had, Rafi struggled for months with frustration, unable to accept that his body would not return to its previous condition.

An older relative who had faced a similar limitation years earlier shared that acceptance did not mean giving up entirely, but adjusting his expectations while trusting there was wisdom in his new circumstances.

Slowly, Rafi began exploring other physical activities better suited to his new limitations, finding unexpected enjoyment in something he would never have tried had his original ability remained unchanged.
Looking back a year later, Rafi admitted that accepting the change, rather than continuously fighting against it, allowed him to discover a version of an active life he had not previously considered.
